records.text: To make Hell's Angels, he actually assembled the largest private air force in the world. He was also an aerospace engineer in 1932. Howard Hughes founded the Hughes Aircraft Company, started off by renting a hangar within Lockheed Aircraft.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
